spans.s: [hrada, pool, only m.; not nt. Mv 〔i.237.12〕 (prose), where interpret hrada-m-(hiatus-bridging)-iva accho anāvilo.]

? hrāsi (for hrāse, loc. of hrāsa, diminution?), is obscure to me; occurs five times in a series of śloka vss (in many of which both meter and sense are bad, as the text is printed) in Mmk, evidently dealing with astronomical portents: tato hrāsi madhyāhne (submetrical! as 4th syllable from end, -i could be m.c. for -e) aparāhne divākare Mmk 〔276.6〕; tamo (read tato with all the rest ? or contrariwise, should they all be emended to tamo for tato ?) hrāsi-gate bhānoḥ kṣmākampo yadi jāyate ib. 〔11〕; tato hrāsi yāme vai (submetrical) calite vasumatī tadā (! hypermetric) 〔277.1〕; tato hrāsi yāmānte (submetrical) dṛśyate karma dāruṇam 〔3〕; tato hrāsi-madhye tu (submetrical) ante yāme prajāyate 〔17〕.
